composition_subtypes.role: Analyze each bit of pairwise sums to compute parity
Sort by masked value to enable two-pointer counting

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorts array by masked value, then for each bit uses two-pointer counting on sorted masked array to count pairs with that bit set, accumulating XOR of parity bits.
payload.rationale: Combines sorting (custom key by masked bits) for efficient range counting and bit manipulation (per-bit parity analysis) to solve XOR of all pairwise sums.
